source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 14 (PDF 305-322), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 14 (Atmosphere) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.
Introduction: major, minor and trace components

blocks.prompt:
1 How are the components of the atmosphere classified? Give examples of each class.
(Atmosphere ke components ki darja bandi kaise ki jati hai? Har darje ki misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Atmosphere ke components major, minor aur trace mein taqseem hain. Major: nitrogen (taqreeban 78%), oxygen (taqreeban 21%). Minor: argon (0.93%), CO₂ (0.04%). Trace: methane, hydrogen, neon, helium, krypton, xenon.

book_ref.quote: The component of the atmospheres may be divided into major, minor and trace components.

blocks.prompt:
2 Name the four layers of the atmosphere in order from the ground upward. On what basis are they distinguished?
(Atmosphere ki chaar layers zameen se upar ki tarteeb mein likhein. Inhein kis bunyad par alag kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Troposphere (0-12 km), stratosphere (12-50 km), mesosphere (50-85 km), thermosphere (85-600 km). Inhein bulandi ke saath temperature ki tabdeeli se alag kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The atmosphere has four distinct layers

blocks.prompt:
3 Give two features of the troposphere.
(Troposphere ki do khususiyaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Yeh sab se neechi aur ghani teh hai, 12 km tak, jis mein N₂, O₂, CO₂ jaisi bari gases hain. (2) Barish, bijli aur toofan isi mein hote hain; temperature 17 °C se -58 °C tak girta hai.

book_ref.quote: It is the layer in which major events such as rain, lightning, and hurricanes occur.

blocks.prompt:
4 The temperature in the troposphere falls from 17 °C at the ground to -58 °C at 12 km. Find the total fall and the average fall per kilometre.
(Troposphere mein temperature zameen par 17 °C se 12 km par -58 °C tak girta hai. Kul kami aur fi kilometre ausat kami nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Kul kami = 17 − (−58) = 75 °C. Ausat kami = 75 °C ÷ 12 km = 6.25 °C fi km.

book_ref.quote: In this region, temperature decreases from 17 °C to -58 °C regularly.

blocks.prompt:
5 How does UV radiation divide the stratosphere into three regions?
(UV shuaen stratosphere ko teen hisson mein kaise taqseem karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Upper: ozone taaqatwar UV jazb kar ke toot jati hai, O₃ → O₂ + O. Middle: kam UV; O₂ + O → O₃ (exothermic), ozone layer banti hai. Lower: bohat kam UV, is liye monoatomic oxygen nahi aur ozone nahi banti.

book_ref.quote: Stratosphere can also be divided into three regions according to the distribution of ultraviolet radiations

blocks.prompt:
6 Write the equations for the breakdown and formation of ozone in the stratosphere.
(Stratosphere mein ozone ke tootne aur banne ki equations likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tootna (upper hissa, UV roshni): O₃(g) → O₂(g) + O(g) (hν ke saath).
Banna (middle hissa, exothermic): O₂(g) + O(g) → O₃(g).

book_ref.quote: Here, monoatomic oxygen and diatomic oxygen recombine to form ozone

blocks.prompt:
7 Why is the mesosphere called the coldest region of the atmosphere?
(Mesosphere ko atmosphere ka sab se thanda hissa kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mesosphere (taqreeban 50-85 km) mein temperature bulandi ke saath -2 °C se -93 °C tak girta hai, jo kisi bhi teh se kam hai; is liye sab se thanda hissa isi mein hai.

book_ref.quote: Here, the temperature decreases with altitude from -2 °C to -93 °C.

blocks.prompt:
8 Why does the temperature of the thermosphere increase with altitude?
(Thermosphere ka temperature bulandi ke saath kyun barhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thermosphere (85-600 km) Suraj ki taaqatwar UV aur X-rays jazb karta hai; is jazb se temperature barhta hai jo upper thermosphere mein 500 °C se 2000 °C ya zyada ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: This is the region where the temperature increases as the altitude increases.

blocks.prompt:
9 Differentiate between the mesosphere and the thermosphere.
(Mesosphere aur thermosphere mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Mesosphere mein temperature bulandi ke saath girta hai; thermosphere mein barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: It extends from 85 km to 600 km above the earth surface.

rows: Zameen se taqreeban 50-85 km
Zameen se 85 km se 600 km
Bulandi ke saath temperature ghatta hai, -2 °C se -93 °C
Bulandi ke saath temperature barhta hai
Atmosphere ka sab se thanda hissa isi mein
Upper hissa 500 °C se 2000 °C ya zyada
Taaqatwar UV aur X-rays jazb kar ke garam hota hai

blocks.prompt:
10 Differentiate between primary and secondary pollutants with one example each.
(Primary aur secondary pollutants mein farq misaal ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Primary pollutants seedhe kharij hote hain; secondary un ke reactions se bante hain.

book_ref.quote: Air pollutants can be classified as primary and secondary.

rows: Seedhe paida ya kharij hote hain
Primary pollutants ke chemical reactions se bante hain
Misaal: volcano ki raakh; gaari ke dhuen ki CO
Misaal: photochemical smog mein banne wali ozone aur PAN

blocks.prompt:
11 What are NOₓ and SOₓ?
(NOₓ aur SOₓ kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: NOₓ nitrogen ke oxides NO aur NO₂ ka mushtarka naam hai. SOₓ sulphur ke oxides SO₂ aur SO₃ ka mushtarka naam hai. Dono ahem air pollutants hain.

book_ref.quote: Oxides of Sulphur (SO₂ and SO₃) collectively known as SOₓ

blocks.prompt:
12 Differentiate between mobile and point sources of air pollution.
(Hawai aaloodgi ke mobile aur point sources mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Mobile sources chalte phirte hain; point sources aik jagah qaim hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Such sources can be classified as either mobile (cars, trucks, air planes, marine engines)

rows: Jagah badalne wale (chalte phirte) zariye
Aik jagah qaim zariye
Misalein: gaariyan, truck, hawai jahaz, samandari engine
Misalein: factories, bijli ghar

blocks.prompt:
13 Which pollutants are produced when fossil fuels are burnt in vehicle engines, factories and power plants? Name two other burning practices that pollute the air.
(Gaariyon, factories aur bijli gharon mein fossil fuels jalne se kaun se pollutants bante hain? Do aur jalane ke tareeqe batayein jo hawa aalooda karte hain.)
blocks.explanation: Coal, fuel oil aur natural gas jalne se CO₂, CO aur hydrocarbons (CH₄) bante hain. Ghar mein lakri jalana aur eenton ke bhattoon mein coal jalana bhi hawa aalooda karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The burning of wood as a domestic fuel and coal in brick kilns are also the sources of air pollutants.

blocks.prompt:
14 Write equations for the formation of CO and CO₂ from carbon. Which one forms in a limited supply of oxygen?
(Carbon se CO aur CO₂ banne ki equations likhein. Kam oxygen mein kaun si banti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
2C(s) + O₂(g) → 2CO(g) (namukammal combustion)
C(s) + O₂(g) → CO₂(g) (combustion)
CO namukammal jalne se, yaani kam oxygen mein banti hai.

book_ref.quote: Carbon monoxide (CO) is produced mainly due to incomplete combustion of fossil fuels.

blocks.prompt:
15 Why is carbon monoxide poisonous? How can CO poisoning be treated?
(Carbon monoxide zehreeli kyun hai? Is ke zehar ka ilaj kaise hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: CO khoon ki haemoglobin se oxygen se zyada mazbooti se judti hai, is liye oxygen saans ke amal se bahar ho jati hai aur dam ghut jata hai. Zyada pressure wali oxygen de kar zehar utara ja sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Carbon monoxide is highly poisonous gas and cause suffocation if inhale.

blocks.prompt:
16 Why is carbon dioxide called a primary greenhouse gas?
(Carbon dioxide ko primary greenhouse gas kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: CO₂ fossil fuels jalane jaisi insani sargarmiyon se nikalne wali ahem greenhouse gas hai. Yeh atmosphere mein garmi qaid karti hai jis se global warming hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Carbon dioxide is the key greenhouse gas emitted by human activities like combustion of fossil fuels.

blocks.prompt:
17 Write the reactions by which NOₓ is produced.
(NOₓ banne ke reactions likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
N₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO(g) (zyada temperature par; nitric oxide)
2NO(g) + O₂ → 2NO₂ (nitrogen dioxide)
NOₓ aam tor par fossil fuels jalane se banta hai.

book_ref.quote: The gases like nitric oxide (NO) and nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) are represented by NOₓ.

blocks.prompt:
18 Give the natural and human sources of N₂O and state two of its harmful effects.
(N₂O ke qudrati aur insani zariye aur is ke do nuqsanat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Qudrati: mitti aur samandar mein bacteria ka nitrogen compounds torna. Insani: kheti (masnooi khaad) aur sanati combustion. Nuqsanat: ozone layer kam karti hai aur climate change mein hissa daalti hai.

book_ref.quote: The increased levels of N₂O contribute to climate change and can also affect air quality.

blocks.prompt:
19 What are SOₓ? Give their main source and one harmful effect.
(SOₓ kya hain? In ka bara zariya aur aik nuqsan likhein.)
blocks.explanation: SOₓ sulphur ke do oxides SO₂ aur SO₃ hain. Yeh zyada tar coal aur tel jalane se nikalte hain. Paani ke bukharat se mil kar acid rain banate hain jo ecosystem ko nuqsan deti hai.

book_ref.quote: When SOₓ combine water vapour, it causes acid rain that damages ecosystem.

blocks.prompt:
20 Give two natural and two human sources of hydrocarbons in the air.
(Hawa mein hydrocarbons ke do qudrati aur do insani zariye likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Qudrati: paude, jangal ki aag, volcano, seeps (risao). Insani: fossil fuels ka namukammal jalna, tel ka phailao, sanati aur gaariyon ka dhuan (gaariyan sab se bara zariya). Methane sab se aam hydrocarbon pollutant hai.

book_ref.quote: Hydrocarbons are produced naturally in various environmental processes like vegetation, wildfire, volcanoes, and seeps.

blocks.prompt:
21 Why is low-altitude ozone harmful to materials?
(Zameen ke qareeb ozone cheezon ke liye nuqsan deh kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ozone taaqatwar oxidizing agent hai. Zameen ke qareeb yeh insanon aur paudon ko nuqsan deti hai aur rubber, kapre ke rang aur paint ki mazbooti aur shakal kharab karti hai.

book_ref.quote: It is harmful to humans, plants and other materials

blocks.prompt:
22 What is ozone depletion? Which compounds mainly cause it?
(Ozone depletion kya hai? Yeh zyada tar kin compounds se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stratosphere mein ozone ki miqdaar kam hona ozone depletion hai. Yeh chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) se hoti hai jo gas ya kam boiling point wale liquids hain aur aerosols aur refrigerants mein istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: These compounds exist as gases or low boiling liquids at room temperature and are used as aerosols or refrigerants.

blocks.prompt:
23 Write the steps in which a chlorine free radical from CFCl₃ destroys ozone.
(CFCl₃ se banne wala chlorine free radical ozone ko kin qadmon mein tabah karta hai, likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
CFCl₃ → CFCl₂ + Cl• (UV)
Cl• + O₃ → ClO• + O₂
ClO• + O → Cl• + O₂
Cl• dobara azad hota hai, is liye doosra aur teesra qadam bar bar dohraye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: The chloride free radical breaks down the Ozone molecule as shown in the following reactions.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ne teesra qadam ClO• + O₂ → Cl• + O₂ chhapa hai jo balanced nahi (Book correction). Durust qadam ClO• + O → Cl• + O₂ hai: oxygen atom ClO• se oxygen le leta hai aur Cl• phir azad ho kar agli O₃ torta hai.

blocks.prompt:
24 Why can a very small amount of CFC destroy a large amount of ozone?
(CFC ki bohat thori miqdaar bhi ozone ki bari miqdaar kyun tabah kar sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aakhri qadam mein chlorine free radical dobara banta hai jo agli O₃ torta hai; doosra aur teesra qadam bar bar hote hain. Is liye aik CFC molecule 100,000 tak ozone molecules tabah kar sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: The decomposition of one molecule of CFCs can destroy up to 100,000 molecules of ozone.

blocks.prompt:
25 Why is the particle set free from CFCs by UV light called a chlorine free radical and not a chloride?
(UV roshni se CFCs se azad hone wale zarre ko chloride ki bajaye chlorine free radical kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chloride Cl⁻ ion hai. UV se azad hone wala zarra neutral chlorine atom hai jis mein aik akela (unpaired) electron hai, Cl•, is liye yeh chlorine free radical hai.

book_ref.quote: where they are broken down by UV radiation creating chloride free radical (Cl•)

blocks.prompt:
26 What are PAHs? Give three examples.
(PAHs kya hain? Teen misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) kai jure hue aromatic rings wale hydrocarbons hain; yeh aam mahooliyati pollutants hain. Misalein: naphthalene, anthracene, phenanthrene.

book_ref.quote: Naphthalene, anthracene and phenanthrene are examples of PAHs. They have potential toxicity and carcinogenic properties.

blocks.prompt:
27 Give the human and natural sources of PAHs.
(PAHs ke insani aur qudrati zariye likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Insani: fossil fuels (coal, tel, petrol, lakri) ka namukammal jalna, gaariyon ka dhuan, sanati amal aur grill khane. Qudrati: khuli aag, petroleum aur coal ke zakhair ka qudrati risao.

book_ref.quote: Some PAHs in the environment originate from the natural sources such as open burning

blocks.prompt:
28 Why are POPs called persistent? Name two POPs with their uses.
(POPs ko persistent kyun kaha jata hai? Do POPs aur un ke istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh kimiyai, hayatiyati aur photolytic amal se nahi toot'te, is liye der tak qaim reh kar mahol mein jama hote hain. PCBs: bijli ka saman, ink, adhesives, paint. DDT: kheti mein insecticide.

book_ref.quote: Owing to their persistence, they accumulate in the environment

blocks.prompt:
29 What are VOCs? Give four examples.
(VOCs kya hain? Chaar misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: VOCs organic compounds ka bara group hain jo kamre ke temperature par asaani se urr jate hain aur kuch solids ya liquids se gas ban kar nikalte hain. Misalein: benzene, toluene, formaldehyde, acetone.

book_ref.quote: VOCs are emitted as gases from certain solids or liquids.

blocks.prompt:
30 Differentiate between the short-term and long-term health effects of VOCs.
(VOCs ke kam arse aur lambe arse ke sehat ke asraat mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kam arse mein jalan aur takleef; lambe arse mein aaza ko nuqsan.

book_ref.quote: Exposure to VOCs can cause a variety of health effects

rows: Aankh, naak aur gale ki jalan
Jigar (liver) ko nuqsan
Sar dard
Gurde (kidney) ko nuqsan
Matli (nausea)
Central nervous system ko nuqsan

blocks.prompt:
31 Define particulate matter and state what it is composed of.
(Particulate matter ki definition likhein aur batayein yeh kis se bana hota hai.)
blocks.explanation: Particulate matter (PM) hawa mein tairte barik thos zarre, maye qatre ya dono hain (dust, dhuan, dhund). Yeh acids, organic chemicals, metals aur mitti ya dust ke zarron se bana hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Particulate matter (PM) comprises acids, organic chemicals, metals, and soil or dust particles.

blocks.prompt:
32 Differentiate between the natural and man-made sources of particulate matter.
(Particulate matter ke qudrati aur insani zariyon mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: PM qudrat aur insani sargarmiyon dono se aata hai.

book_ref.quote: Sources of PM are both natural and anthropogenic.

rows: Volcano
Mashini aur sanati amal mein combustion
Aag
Gaariyon ka dhuan
Mitti ke toofan aur hawa mein samandari namak
Tambaku ka dhuan

blocks.text: 14.5.1 Impact of burning fossil fuels on the atmosphere

blocks.prompt:
33 State the impact of burning fossil fuels on the atmosphere.
(Fossil fuels jalane ka atmosphere par kya asar hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fossil fuels jalana maujooda climate change ki bunyadi wajah hai; yeh greenhouse gases, hawai aaloodgi aur VOCs ke zariye ecosystem badalta aur insani aur mahooliyati sehat ke masail paida karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Some of these ways include greenhouse gas emission, air pollution, volatile organic compounds.

blocks.text: 14.5.2 Impact of deforestation on the atmosphere

blocks.prompt:
34 Define deforestation. Give its negative impacts on the environment.
(Deforestation ki definition likhein. Mahol par is ke manfi asraat batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Deforestation insanon ka jaan boojh kar jangal saaf ya kam karna hai. Is ke manfi asraat: biodiversity (hayati tanawwo) ka khatma, climate change, mitti ki kharabi aur paani ke cycle mein khalal.

book_ref.quote: Deforestation represents one of the largest issues in global climate.

blocks.prompt:
35 Name the two most important effects of air pollutants.
(Air pollutants ke do sab se ahem asraat ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Air pollutants ke sab se ahem aur aam asraat smog aur acid rain ka banna hain.

book_ref.quote: The most important and commonly effects of air pollutants are formation of Smog and Acid Rain.

blocks.prompt:
36 What is smog? What does it consist of?
(Smog kya hai? Yeh kin cheezon par mushtamil hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Smog ghane dhundle pan wali aaloodgi hai, zyada tar shehron mein. Is mein barik dust ya soot, jame hue bukharat, zehreeli gases (SO₂, NOₓ, O₃, CO, CO₂), unburned hydrocarbons, VOCs aur PM 10-2.5 micron hote hain.

book_ref.quote: It consists of fine dust or soot particles, condensed water vapor

blocks.prompt:
37 Differentiate between classical smog and photochemical smog.
(Classical smog aur photochemical smog mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Classical smog SOₓ se; photochemical smog dhoop mein NOₓ aur VOCs se banti hai.

book_ref.quote: usually results from high quantities of sulfur oxides (SOₓ) being released into the air

rows: Industrial, reducing ya London smog bhi kehte hain
Los Angeles smog bhi kehte hain
Hawa mein SOₓ ki ziyada miqdaar se banti hai
NOₓ, VOCs aur unburned hydrocarbons ke photochemical reactions se banti hai
Dhoop ki maujoodgi mein banti hai
Secondary pollutants ozone aur PAN banti hain; zyada khatarnak

blocks.prompt:
38 Define acid rain. Why is clean rain itself slightly acidic?
(Acid rain ki definition likhein. Saaf barish khud thori tezabi kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acid rain woh barish, barf ya ole hain jin ka pH 5.6 se kam ho; is ki corrosive (galane wali) fitrat bohat nuqsan karti hai. Saaf barish mein CO₂ ghulti hai, is liye us ka pH taqreeban 5.6 hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Its corrosive nature causes widespread damage to the environment.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'pH less than 5-6' chhapa hai; durust had 5.6 hai (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
39 How can acid rain reach places far from factories and power plants?
(Acid rain factories aur bijli gharon se door jagahon tak kaise pohanch sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fossil fuels ki SOₓ aur NOₓ hawa ki nami se mil kar acids banati hain. Hawa in tezabi qatron ko bohat door le jati hai, phir yeh acid rain, ole, barf ya dhund ban kar girte hain.

book_ref.quote: Finally, these droplets return to the ground as acid rain, acid hail, snow and even fog.

blocks.prompt:
40 Differentiate between the greenhouse effect and global warming.
(Greenhouse effect aur global warming mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Greenhouse effect garam hone ka amal hai; global warming temperature ka lamba izafa hai.

book_ref.quote: The progressive warming up of the earth’s surface due to blanketing effect of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere is called the greenhouse effect.

rows: Greenhouse gases ke kambal jaise asar se zameen ki satah ka barhta garam hona
Zameen ke ausat satahi temperature mein lamba izafa
Gases ke infrared shuaen jazb karne par mabni
Insani sargarmiyon, khaas tor par fossil fuels ki GHGs se

blocks.prompt:
41 How do greenhouse gases prevent loss of heat from the earth at night?
(Greenhouse gases raat ko zameen ki garmi ka nuqsan kaise rokti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Din mein Suraj ki infrared garmi atmosphere se guzar kar zameen garam karti hai. Raat ko zameen garmi khala ki taraf chhorti hai magar kuch gases is garmi ko qaid kar ke us ka nuqsan rok deti hain.

book_ref.quote: At night, the earth radiate heat to the outer space.

blocks.prompt:
42 How does the concentration of CO₂ affect global temperature?
(CO₂ ki miqdaar aalmi temperature par kaise asar daalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: CO₂ aur doosri greenhouse gases ki miqdaar jitni zyada, garmi ki shuaon ka jazb utna zyada aur aalmi temperature ka izafa utna zyada.

book_ref.quote: Higher the concentration of carbon dioxide gas and other gases

blocks.prompt:
43 Differentiate between good and poor air quality.
(Achhi aur kharab hawa (air quality) mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Achhi hawa saaf aur kam aalooda; kharab hawa dhundli aur nuqsan deh.

book_ref.quote: When the air quality is good, the air is clear and contains only small amount of solid particles and chemical pollutants.

rows: Hawa saaf hoti hai
Hawa aksar dhundli hoti hai
Thos zarre aur chemical pollutants kam hote hain
Pollutants zyada hote hain
AQI 50 se kam; bahar waqt guzarna mehfooz
Sehat aur mahol ke liye khatarnak; 300 se zyada AQI hazardous

blocks.prompt:
44 Which people are at high risk when the AQI is over 300?
(Jab AQI 300 se zyada ho to kaun log zyada khatre mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: 18 se kam umar ke bachay, 65 se zyada umar ke log aur dil aur phephron ke purane mareez. Bahar kaam karne wale lambe arse tak saamne rehne ki wajah se zyada khatre mein hain.

book_ref.quote: Children under 18, adult over 65, people with chronic heart, and lung diseases are under high-risk.

blocks.prompt:
45 AQI readings of 45, 160 and 320 are recorded in three cities. State the level of health concern and colour for each.
(Teen shehron mein AQI 45, 160 aur 320 hai. Har aik ka health concern level aur rang batayein.)
blocks.explanation: 45 (0-50): Good, hara. 160 (151-200): Unhealthy, laal. 320 (301-500): Hazardous, maroon.

book_ref.quote: Table 14.2 AQI and level of health concern

blocks.prompt:
46 How do meteorological conditions affect air quality?
(Mausami halaat (meteorological conditions) hawa ke mayaar par kaise asar daalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hawa, temperature aur nami pollutants ke phailne aur un ki miqdaar par asar daalte hain. Garam hawa ki teh pollutants ko zameen ke qareeb qaid kar ke hawa kharab kar sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: Wind, temperature, and humidity affect pollutant dispersion and concentration.

blocks.prompt:
47 How do seasonal changes affect air quality?
(Mausami tabdeeliyan hawa ke mayaar par kaise asar daalti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif mausamon mein imaraton ko garam ya thanda karne se pollutants ka ikhraj barhta hai, aur mausami pollen bhi hawa kharab karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Temperature variations, such as heating or cooling of buildings in different seasons can increase emissions of pollutants.

blocks.prompt:
48 Name the pollutants released by (i) factories and power plants (ii) vehicles.
(Batayein kaun se pollutants kharij hote hain: (i) factories aur bijli ghar (ii) gaariyan.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Factories aur bijli ghar fossil fuels jala kar SOₓ aur NOₓ chhorte hain. (ii) Gaariyan CO, PM aur VOCs chhorti hain.

book_ref.quote: Factories and power plants use fossil fuels that release dangerous pollutants in air like SOₓ and NOₓ.

blocks.text: 14.9.1 Major air pollutants and their health effects

blocks.prompt:
49 State the short-term and long-term effects of NO₂ and SO₂ on health.
(NO₂ aur SO₂ ke sehat par kam arse aur lambe arse ke asraat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: NO₂ aur SO₂ se kam arse ka wasta saans ke nizam mein jalan karta hai; lamba wasta saans ki infection, asthma aur bronchitis ka khatra barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: The short-term exposures of NO₂ and SO₂ can irritate the respiratory system

blocks.text: 14.10 Potential health risks associated with air pollution

blocks.prompt:
50 On what factors do the health effects of air pollution depend?
(Hawai aaloodgi ke sehat par asraat kin factors par munhasir hain?)
blocks.explanation: Asraat acute (fauri) ya chronic (purane) ho sakte hain aur pollutant ki qisam aur miqdaar, wasta parne ki muddat aur shakhsi kamzori par munhasir hain.

book_ref.quote: vary depending on the type and concentration of pollutants, duration of exposure and individual weakness

blocks.text: 14.10.1 Main health risks associated with air pollution

blocks.prompt:
51 How does air pollution cause respiratory diseases?
(Hawai aaloodgi saans ki bimariyan kaise paida karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ozone, PM aur NO₂ asthma ki alamaat barha kar daura la sakte hain. Lamba wasta purani khansi aur pneumonia jaisi infections paida kar sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Long term exposure may lead to chronic cough and respiratory infections like pneumonia.

blocks.prompt:
52 How does air pollution affect the heart and blood vessels?
(Hawai aaloodgi dil aur khoon ki nalyon par kaise asar daalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: PM aur doosre pollutants soojan, khoon ki nalyon ko nuqsan aur high blood pressure paida karte hain, jis se dil ke daure aur aakhir stroke ka khatra barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: by causing inflammation, blood vessel damage, high blood pressure and finally heart stroke

blocks.prompt:
53 State the reproductive and developmental effects of air pollution.
(Hawai aaloodgi ke tolidi (reproductive) aur nashonuma ke asraat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hawai aaloodgi mard aur aurat dono ki tolidi sehat aur fertility ko nuqsan de sakti hai; waqt se pehle paidaish aur bachon mein nashonuma ke masail ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: Exposure to air pollution may negatively impact reproductive health and fertility in both man and women.

blocks.text: 14.11 Methods and techniques to measure and monitor air quality

blocks.prompt:
54 What is a nephelometer? How does it work?
(Nephelometer kya hai? Yeh kaise kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nephelometer (photometer) AQI naapne ka aala hai; yeh dust, dhuan, dhund aur fumes jaise PM monitor karta hai. Yeh zarraat se bikharne wali kul roshni naap kar unhein pehchanta hai.

book_ref.quote: Nephelometer, also known as photometer, detects particles by measuring the total amount of light they scatter.

blocks.prompt:
55 Name the pollutants whose concentrations are assessed when air quality is monitored.
(Hawa ke mayaar ki monitoring mein kin pollutants ki miqdaar dekhi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Particulate matter (PM), nitrogen dioxide (NO₂), sulphur dioxide (SO₂), carbon monoxide (CO), ozone (O₃) aur volatile organic compounds (VOCs).

book_ref.quote: These pollutants can include particulates matter (PM), nitrogen dioxides (NO₂), sulphur dioxide (SO₂)

blocks.prompt:
56 Differentiate between Air Quality Monitoring Stations and remote sensing techniques.
(Air Quality Monitoring Stations aur remote sensing techniques mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: AQMS qaim jagahon par foran naapte hain; remote sensing satellites se bare raqbe par.

book_ref.quote: Fixed monitoring stations are equipped with various sensors and analyzers to measure pollutant level in real time

rows: Sensors aur analysers wale qaim stations
Sensors wale satellites
Foran (real time) pollutants naapte hain
Bare raqbe par pollutants naapte hain
Shehri aur sanati ilaqon mein
Ilaqai aur aalmi air quality ka data dete hain

blocks.prompt:
57 What is CEMS? Which pollutants can it monitor?
(CEMS kya hai? Yeh kin pollutants ko monitor kar sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: CEMS (Continuous Emission Monitoring System) sanati jagahon par istemal hone wala direct pemaish ka tareeqa hai. Yeh CO, O₃, SO₂, NO₂, VOCs aur PM monitor karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Continuous emission monitoring system (CEMS) can usually monitor gas

blocks.text: 14.12 Experiments and data collection to test a hypothesis about air quality

blocks.prompt:
58 Give an example of a hypothesis about air quality and say how it can be tested.
(Air quality ke baare mein aik hypothesis ki misaal dein aur batayein usay kaise jaancha ja sakta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Hypothesis: shehron mein PM 2.5 aur NO₂ ki miqdaar rush ke auqaat mein ghair-rush auqaat se zyada hoti hai. Isay din ke mukhtalif auqaat mein air quality ka data jama kar ke jaancha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: can be tested by collecting air quality data at different time of the day

blocks.prompt:
59 What is done during the data-collection step of an air-quality experiment?
(Air quality ke tajurbe ke data jama karne wale qadam mein kya kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rush aur ghair-rush auqaat mein traffic ki miqdaar ka data jama kar ke muqabla kiya jata hai, aur qabil-e-aitmaad aalaat aur tareeqe istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: The data on traffic volume during rush hours and non-rush hours is collected and finally compared.

blocks.text: 14.13 Analyse data and interpret air quality

blocks.prompt:
60 What is done with the data collected in an air-quality experiment?
(Air quality ke tajurbe mein jama kiye gaye data ka kya kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jama data ka analysis hypothesis ke sach ya ghalat hone ki tasdeeq ke liye hota hai; phir nataij ki tashreeh aur nateeja nikala jata hai taa ke air quality behtar karne ki hikmat-e-amli bane.

book_ref.quote: The results of the analysis are interpreted and concluded.

blocks.text: 14.14 Strategies used to reduce air pollution

blocks.prompt:
61 What is the function of a diesel particulate filter?
(Diesel particulate filter ka kaam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: DPF jadeed diesel engines mein exhaust se nuqsan deh PM kam karne ke liye lagaya jata hai. Is ka bunyadi kaam exhaust se soot ke zarre pakar kar jama karna hai.

book_ref.quote: Diesel particulate filter (DPF) is incorporated in modern diesel engines

blocks.prompt:
62 How does selective catalytic reduction (SCR) clean exhaust gases?
(Selective catalytic reduction (SCR) exhaust gases ko kaise saaf karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Diesel engines mein SCR urea se bani ammonia ke zariye NOₓ ko N₂ aur H₂O mein reduce karta hai; is mein TiO₂ aur zeolites jaise catalysts hote hain. CO aur hydrocarbons ko alag oxidation catalyst oxidize karta hai, SCR nahi.

book_ref.quote: SCR is used in diesel engines to remove pollutants from the emission gases.

blocks.prompt:
63 What are scrubbers? Name the pollutants they control.
(Scrubbers kya hain? Yeh kin pollutants ko control karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Scrubbers liquids (maslan paani) se sanati exhaust ki SO₂ aur PM jaise pollutants nikalte hain. Yeh PM, SO₂, HCl, NH₃ aur VOCs control karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Scrubbers can be used to control wide range of pollutants including particulate matters, SO₂, HCl, NH₃ and VOCs.

blocks.prompt:
64 Differentiate between a catalytic convertor and a diesel particulate filter.
(Catalytic convertor aur diesel particulate filter mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Catalytic convertor nuqsan deh gases badalta hai; DPF soot ke zarre pakarta hai.

book_ref.quote: Oxides of nitrogen and other undesirable gases such as CO and various unburnt hydrocarbon are emitted by the vehicle engines.

rows: Aksar gaariyon mein laga hota hai
Jadeed diesel engines mein lagaya jata hai
Nuqsan deh gases ko beziyaan maaddon mein badalta hai
Soot ke zarre pakar kar jama karta hai
CO → CO₂; NOₓ → N₂; hydrocarbons → CO₂ + H₂O
PM ka ikhraj kam karta hai

blocks.prompt:
65 Name the laws and standards to control air pollution in Pakistan.
(Pakistan mein hawai aaloodgi rokne ke qawaneen aur standards ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Pakistan Environmental Protection Act (PEPA 1997); National Environmental Quality Standards (NEQS), PEPA 1997 ke tehat qaumi hadood; Punjab Environmental Protection (Amendment) Act 2012.

book_ref.quote: Common rules and regulations to control air pollution in Pakistan is given below:

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'Natural Environmental Quality Standard' chhapa hai; durust naam National Environmental Quality Standards hai (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
66 What is the vehicle emission standard?
(Vehicle emission standard kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh motor gaariyon ki aaloodgi kam karne ke liye nafiz kiya jata hai. Is mein CNG aur LPG jaise saaf eendhan aur fuel quality par sticker ka qanoon shamil hai.

book_ref.quote: Enforcement of this standard is to reduce pollution from motor vehicles.

blocks.prompt:
67 Why is the use of open fire for disposal of waste prohibited?
(Kachra khuli aag mein jalane par pabandi kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ghar aur sanaton ka kachra khuli aag mein jalane se dust, dhuan aur bohat se air pollutants bante hain, is liye is par pabandi hai.

book_ref.quote: Using open fire to bulk domestic and industrial waste can produce dust, smoke and significant amount of air pollutants.

blocks.prompt:
68 What is the role of public awareness campaigns in controlling air pollution?
(Hawai aaloodgi rokne mein awami aagahi muhim ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh logon ko aaloodgi ke zariyon, asraat aur apna hissa kam karne ke tareeqe batati hain aur public transport, carpooling, cycling aur paidal chalne ko farogh deti hain.

book_ref.quote: Educating the public about the sources and effect of air pollution

blocks.prompt:
69 Give two economic issues caused by air pollution.
(Hawai aaloodgi ke do maashi (economic) masail likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Kharab hawa bimari aur ghair haaziri se mazdooron ki paidawar kam karti hai. (2) Faslon ko nuqsan, paidawar kam aur khane ki qeematein zyada. Acid rain imaraton aur pulon ko bhi kharab karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Air pollution and air quality can damage crops reducing agricultural yield and increasing food prices.

blocks.prompt:
70 Give two social issues caused by air pollution.
(Hawai aaloodgi ke do samaji (social) masail likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Bachay, boorhe aur kam aamdani wale log zyada mutasir hote hain. (2) Shadeed aaloodgi logon ko hijrat par majboor karti hai jis se samaji be-ghari hoti hai. Lamba wasta zindagi ka mayaar bhi girata hai.

book_ref.quote: Vulnerable populations, such as children, the elderly, and low-income communities are disproportionately affected by air pollution.

blocks.prompt:
71 Why can implementing air quality regulations lead to political problems?
(Air quality ke qawaneen nafiz karna siyasi masail kyun paida kar sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Siyasi aur maashi mafadaat ki wajah se qawaneen mushkil hain. In ke liye sakht hukmrani chahiye jo sanati taraqqi sust kar ke siyasi jhagre la sakti hai; aaloodgi sarhad paar bhi jati hai, is liye bain-ul-aqwami taawun chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Implementing effective air quality regulations can be challenging due to political and economic interests.
